name: GZCLP
author: Cody Lefever (GZCL) · sheet v4.5b5 by /u/Blacknoir
summary: Linear progression in three tiers. T1 heavy triples, T2 volume, T3 pump work. Rep schemes step down when you stall.

overview: 4 sessions a week · four different days
Open-ended: keep running it as long as you progress.

tiers.title: T1 · 5×3+ → 6×2+ → 10×1+
tiers.text: 5×3+ (last set as many reps as you can). Get every rep and add 10 lb on Back Squat and Deadlift and 5 lb on Overhead Press and Bench Press next time. If you miss a rep, move to 6×2+, then 10×1+ at the same weight. When 10×1+ stalls too, test a new 5-rep max and restart at 85% of it.

tiers.title: T2 · 3×10 → 3×8 → 3×6
tiers.text: 3×10. Get every rep and add 5 lb (10 lb on Deadlift) next time. If you miss a rep, move to 3×8, then 3×6 at the same weight. When 3×6 stalls too, go back to 3×10 at the weight you last started it with, plus 10 lb (20 lb on Deadlift).

tiers.title: T3 · 3×15+
tiers.text: 3×15+. When the last set reaches 25 reps, add 5 lb next time; until then, keep the weight and push the last set.

tiers.title: T3 · 4×12+
tiers.text: 4×12+. When the last set reaches 18 reps, add 5 lb next time; until then, keep the weight and push the last set.
